profile.name: Dang Chi Son
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with approximately 12 years of experience, specializing in frontend engineering with Vue.js, React, Angular, and TypeScript. Spent nearly 10 years at NeoLab and DGWAsian following its acquisition in 2023, including around six years leading frontend teams of 6–10 engineers. Experienced in frontend architecture, performance optimization, engineering standards, and delivery of complex web applications. Also builds Node.js backend services, a full-stack personal finance product, and open-source tools integrating AI coding agents through MCP, event hooks, and secure remote workflows. Focused on expanding practical expertise in AI agent engineering.
